title: Fuzzer: `BoneTwistDisperser3D` functions crashes Godot
body:

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable890 = BoneTwistDisperser3D.new()
	temp_variable890.set_setting_count(78)
	temp_variable890.set_end_bone(60, -25)
	temp_variable890.clear_settings()

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
